title: What If You Turned Into A Girl?
description:
What if you woke up one morning and suddenly turned into a girl? 🎀 You look in the mirror and barely recognize yourself. Your hair is longer, your voice sounds completely different, and even your clothes have changed. But the strangest part? Everyone remembers you as a girl, and you're the only one who knows you used to be a guy!

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine life after an impossible overnight transformation: learning to navigate a completely different appearance, dealing with unexpected attention, joining girls' group chats, and discovering how differently your friends might treat you. From awkward school encounters to shopping adventures and unexpected crushes, everyday life could become surprisingly complicated.

Would you enjoy your new life or immediately search for a way to turn back? Imagine discovering that your old best friend barely talks to you anymore, while people you've never been close to suddenly consider you their best friend. And what happens when a boy asks you on a date, or you realize your entire past has somehow been rewritten?

This strange transformation adventure explores identity, friendship, relationships, social expectations, and what it means to see the world from someone else's perspective. With a new appearance but all your old memories, would you still feel like the same person?

And if you finally discovered a way to become a guy again, would you take it—or would you choose to stay a girl?

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:

🧠 What If You Could Hear What Every Girl Thinks About You?  
💘 What If Every Girl on Earth Loved You?

💸 What If You Had Infinite Money?  
👥 What If You Could Clone Yourself?  
⚡ What If You Had Superpowers?

Would you rather turn into a girl for 24 hours or stay that way for an entire year? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more animated what-if scenarios, mysterious transformations, strange superpowers, and impossible adventures!

title: If Everyone In Your Class Stops Writing... NEVER LOOK UP
description:
If you're ever taking a test and everyone in your class stops writing at the same time... do not look up. Don't put your pencil down. Don't raise your hand. And whatever you do, don't look at the clock. There are 7 rules. Most people break the third.

This is an analog horror survival guide for the moment a whole classroon goes silent in the middle of a test: the hand at the next desk frozen mid-word, the shoes under the desks that are all pointed at you, the clock that ticks backwards, the whisper in your best friend's voice, the folded note with your name on it in your own handwriting, the teacher whose shoes are on backwards, and the chemistry class in Orgeon where on girl kept writing the same two words.

FILE 074 - CLASSROOM. Issued by the Department of Domestic Entities. Please listen to all steps.

Every file is one ordinary thing that stops acting ordinary, and the short list of rules that gets you through it. No explanations. Just instructions.

title: What If You And Your Crush Were Alone On A Desert Island?

description:
What if you and your crush were alone on a desert island? No phones. No parents. Just the two of you, one cracked kayak, one emergency flare, and a four-metre crocodile who thinks the island belongs to him.

The wind pushes your kayak out to sea all night, and at six in the morning it cracks on a rock in front of a tiny green island. Sitting in the front is Ruby Cole. Your mums are best friends, she pushed you into a pool when you were six, and she hasn't spoken to you since Year Seven. You've had a crush on her for two years.

Thirty-nine days. Coconuts that go straight through you, one toilet called "behind the big rock", a gang of monkeys that steal your only flare, a storm, a sea urchin, and a boat made from a kayak, two logs and eleven hair ties. And every afternoon at ten past four, a plane that never waves back.

title: If Your Principal Comes Back With A Different Face... AVOID HIM
description:
If your principal ever comes back to school with a different face... avoid him. Don't stare at it. Don't tell him he looks different. And whatever you do, never let him get a good look at you. There are 7 rules, and the last one is the hardest, because at 3:00 the only way out of the building is past him.

This is an analog horror survival guide for one Monday at Westbrook Middle School: a principal back from a two-week "family emergency" wearing a stranger's face, a smile that shows up half a second late, morning announcements where his face slides, teachers who won't look at him, a missing poster taped inside the front office window, security footage from two weeks ago at 6:12 PM, what's under the face, and the last bell

FILE 094 - SCHOOL. Issued by the Department of Domestic Entities. Please listen to all steps.

CHAPTERS

title: What If You Were Frozen for 1,000 Years?
tags: what if you were frozen for 1000 years
what if you woke up 1000 years in the future
description:
▶ NEW VIDEO: What If You Were the Only Man on an Island of 100 Amazons? https://youtu.be/UtXsABU4Cek

What if you were frozen for 1,000 years? This what if animation wakes you up in 3026 with a hundred dollars in the bank, a robot that is more scared than you, and a mystery: somebody kept your pod cold on purpose.

It was supposed to be one night. A lab paid you a hundred bucks. A thousand years of compound interest later, you're the richest person in history. Too bad pizza costs fourteen million a slice, nobody understands your English, and the bank would very much like you to be dead. Then you find a note signed J.

So... who would keep your pod cold for a thousand years? Tell us in the comments.

Real facts in this video
• Moss frozen in Antarctic permafrost for over 1,500 years grew again in the lab: Roads, Longton & Convey, Current Biology 24(6), 2014. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2014.01.053
• English from the year 1026 is unreadable today: the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle entry for that year reads "Her for Ælfric biscop to Rome" ("In this year bishop Ælfric went to Rome"), manuscript D.
• In 1790 Benjamin Franklin left 1,000 pounds to Boston and told the city to wait 200 years; by 1990 the fund was worth about $4.5 million: Education Week, April 1990. https://www.edweek.org/education/benjamin-franklins-penny-saved-means-training-dollars-for-2-cities/1990/04
• US consumer prices rose more than 30 times since 1913 (CPI-U 9.9 in 1913, 313.7 in 2024): U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. https://www.bls.gov/cpi/
• The Moon drifts away from Earth by about 3.8 cm a year, measured by bouncing lasers off the Apollo reflectors: NASA. https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/ApolloLaser.html
• Vint Cerf, one of the fathers of the internet, warned in 2015 of a "digital Dark Age": files nobody keeps copying become unreadable: BBC, February 2015. https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-31450389

Everyone in this video is fictional.

title: What If You Could See When Everyone Becomes a Millionaire?
tags: what if you could see the future
description:
What if you could see the future and know exactly when everyone becomes a millionaire? Your mom flipping pancakes. A man in a $3,000 suit. An old woman counting coins for a loaf of bread, with the shortest number you've seen all day.

The number tells you when. It never tells you what it costs.

In this animated what if story, you look at anyone and see how long until they become a millionaire. Some people are decades away. Some are days away. Once you know, what would you do? Would you hand money to the person with the short number, warn the one with the long number, or keep quiet and keep walking?

Getting rich sounds simple when a number does the work. It stops sounding simple the moment you see who gets there first, and what they give up on the way.

This is a hypothetical scenario about money, wealth and what a number can and can't tell you about a person's life. It is not financial advice and it is not a prediction. Nobody can really see when you will get rich, and no one knows how any of it ends. It is a 2D animation for anyone who likes a good what if.

The number rule, the people and the money are all imagined.

Like what if animations that ask what you would really do? Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@AnyMinuteNowTV?sub_confirmation=1

Tell us in the comments: would you want to see your own number?

#WhatIf #Millionaire #AnimatedStory
